svg.text: checkpoint 1 only counts 15 cm past the line, so we aim past it
The first checkpoint is a line at
the end of the launch corridor.
Aiming at its centre puts the
pin a vertex past the line
A* targets a band 0.18–0.30 m past
the line, at the end nearest the
next gate, and pins that vertex.
margin to spare if MPPI rounds it
